description: ModernBERT-base encoder forward over 512 tokens. TensorRT with Inductor's kernels: the session recipe, the kernels.inductor variants on top of it, a decomposed-attention control with and without the hosted RoPE kernel, and the strongest Inductor configurations

notes.trt-session: The recipe the published agent session selected. --session DIR replaces it with the recipe the session in DIR selected
notes.trt-session-cudagraphs: Control: the session recipe with CUDA graphs, no hybrid
notes.trt-hybrid-*: The session recipe with kernels.inductor set to the value the name gives, and runtime.cudagraphs, its requirement
notes.trt-hybrid-rope-kernel-eager-numerics: The hosted RoPE kernel generated under Inductor's emulate_precision_casts (Hugging Face's FP16 cos/sin rounding)
notes.trt-decompose-*: engine.decompose_attention alone, not the session recipe, with CUDA graphs: a control (trt-decompose-cudagraphs) and the hosted RoPE kernel on top of it; compare those two with each other
notes.inductor-*: The Inductor configurations of the main head-to-head
